description: Retrieves a list of grouping checksums (hashes) generated by Sentry for a specific issue within an organization, used for understanding event aggregation.

inputSchema.description: Request to retrieve hashes for a Sentry issue in an organization.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor to navigate through the list of issue hashes.
cursor.title: Cursor

full.description: If `True`, includes comprehensive details for each hash; if `False`, returns a minimal representation.
full.title: Full

organization_id_or_slug.description: Identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: RetrieveIssueHashesForOrganizationRequest

name: retrieve_issue_hashes_for_organization

IssueHashDetails.description: Details of a single issue hash.

id.description: The hash ID (checksum) used for grouping events into this issue.
id.title: Id

latestEvent.description: Details of the most recent event with this hash (only included when full=True).
latestEvent.title: Latest Event

mergedBySeer.description: Whether this hash was merged by Sentry's AI grouping system.
mergedBySeer.title: Merged By Seer

IssueHashDetails.title: IssueHashDetails

details.description: List of grouping hashes associated with this issue, each representing a unique fingerprint used to aggregate events.
details.title: Details
